principle: Separate APPROVED COMPOSITION from APPROVED MESSAGE from APPROVED CAMPAIGN-SPECIFIC MESSAGE from REFERENCE-ONLY TEXT. A Gold Standard's visible phrases are reference-only unless listed here.

approved_messages.placement: separate text element near the logo or in the band; never inside the logo asset

approved_messages.scope: seller encouragement (individual seller primary; used campaign-specifically in buyer/professional creative)

approved_campaign_specific_messages.text: Amazing Finds Delivered to Your Inbox.

not_approved.why: appears in REF-23; not one of the two approved slogans

not_approved.text: Get Top Dollar / Reach Thousands of Serious Bidders / Low Seller Fees / Higher Realization / Keep More of the Proceeds / Join for Free / Over 250 Lots / Global Buyers
not_approved.why: claims — production truth via the A2 claim manifest or omitted; marketing-package rules forbid promising outcomes

reference_only_text_rule: Everything else visible in a reference (benefit rows, band items, footer strips, script accents, chalkboard/mug/box lettering) is reference-only: it informs tone and density, it is never copied as approved copy, and it never carries a claim into production.
buyer_vs_seller: Buyer creative uses discovery language (finds, discover, unique, updates, browse); seller creative uses capability/ease language (sell, list, reach, grow, cash). Never seller language in buyer creative by default. REF-17 carries buyer language inside the individual-seller Gold folder — an open Owner question, not a precedent.
destinations: CTA wording ('Start Your Auction Today', 'Join for Free', 'View Auction', 'View Catalog', 'Sign Up') is acceptable only when the production Marketing Director supplies a real approved destination; the engine never invents a signup page, form or URL.
